name: SurroundCore
description: A Debian-based multichannel music core with local and network playback, optical and MiniDisc ingest, library storage, and streaming-provider integrations.

notes.text: A privileged LXC is required for optical SCSI and removable-media passthrough used by rip and burn workflows.
MakeMKV is optional third-party software. SurroundCore does not redistribute the MakeMKV binary, licence material, registration keys, or beta keys.
The Proxmox media broker will only offer removable/media devices that are not mounted or claimed by Proxmox storage; declining a device leaves it host-only.
